title: Merida Silex 7000 Gravel Bike Review: The Comfy King of the Bikes We've Ridden in2026

takeaways.text: The testers rate it the most comfortable gravel bike in their series apart from a suspension-equipped Diverge, with relaxed, stable endurance geometry better suited to bikepacking than technical single track.
Their bike had 1× GRX with an MTB cassette and 180 mm rotors with very strong braking; the mechanical shifting skipped until adjusted, and tubeless-ready wheels arrived with tubes.
There are many mounts and a 2× option; fitting mudguards reduces clearance from 45 mm to 42 mm.
Their size-XL test bike weighed about 9.55 kg.

disclosure: How the test bike was supplied is not stated. The bike shown is a 1× GRX build of the Silex 7000, which may differ from the mainland 2025 specification.
summary: A podcast team's 30-day review of the Merida Silex 7000 gravel bike in size XL.
